name: Evil And Wicked People
overview: Scripture reveals that God takes no pleasure in wickedness and cannot tolerate evil dwelling with Him, underscoring His holiness and justice. The wicked are characterized by deceitful speech and a troubled conscience, often fleeing even without pursuit, while the righteous demonstrate boldness and confidence. Believers are encouraged not to envy or fret over evildoers, trusting that God will bring every deed, hidden or open, into judgment. Ultimately, evil leads to destruction and desolation, affirming the certainty of divine justice against those who oppose righteousness.
